learning_outcomes.text: Understand manufacturing technologies of nanometer integrated circuits.
Understand logic circuit operation at the transistor level.
Analyze simple or complex digital circuits.
Synthesize digital circuits at the transistor level.
Solve performance related problems in VLSI circuits.
Design and simulate VLSI circuits, perform measurements on their characteristics and verify their performance.

syllabus_topics: CMOS technology and integrated circuit manufacturing
complex gates and logic families (static, dynamic, Domino, CVSL, pass transistor logic)
Interconnect, clocking strategies and power consumption
Sub-circuit design (adders, counters, multipliers, memories, data paths)
VLSI testing and design for testability techniques
teaching_methods: Use of e-slides and interactive board
Use of computer-aided design tools at the laboratory (circuit design and simulation)
Use of components and instruments (signal generators, power supplies, multi-meters, oscilloscopes) at the laboratory for circuit implementation and measurement
Course website maintenance (announcements and posting of teaching material)
Use of email for information exchange and improved communication with students

assessment_methods.method: Laboratory exercises on circuit design and simulation

assessment_rules: The final examination includes problem solving and is evaluated based on the correctness and completeness of answers, contributing 80% to the final grade. Laboratory exercises on circuit design and simulation are evaluated during work and with a final design project examination, contributing 20% to the final grade. Home-works on problem solving can provide a bonus of up to 10% in case of successful evaluation in the final examination and laboratory exercises.

degree: Computer Science and Engineering (Diploma, 4 years / 240 ECTS, undergraduate programme)
